name: agent-tiers
description: Portable Lead/Worker/Advisor/Reviewer/Boss sub-agent tier system. Ships generalized advisor + worker + reviewer + boss agents, the gating/delegation/session-handoff workflow skills, and an env-probe (/agent-tiers:init) that self-configures per project by discovering how the local GUI resolves sub-agent model/effort overrides. The Lead (main chat) stays GUI-configured; the kit only configures and verifies the sub-agents.

enabled.title: Kit enabled
enabled.description: Turns the whole kit on or off, core hooks included. Off keeps it installed; each session start then shows one line saying it is off.

group_safety.title: Safety guards
group_safety.description: Blocks destructive commands and secrets in written content, bare git add -A and stash, hand-made worktrees; asks or denies agent reach to remote hosts and browser MCPs.

group_shell_footguns.title: Shell footgun guards
group_shell_footguns.description: Stops shell commands that fail quietly: recursive grep skipping binary files, pgrep/pkill -f, and long checks piped into tail or polled in a loop; and machine-wide searches or archive loops that compete with you for the machine.

group_commit_review.title: Commit review guards
group_commit_review.description: Asks before a commit or push with no independent review, flags commit hygiene problems and private text in a commit, denies undisclosed sed -i or tee writes to tracked files, and logs derived numbers.

group_delegation.title: Delegation guards
group_delegation.description: Guards sub-agent spawns (model, framing, return-while-running), bare codex calls, and a sub-agent editing its own definition; a Stop send-back for numbered OOS items a sub-agent handed back with no disposition line.

group_memory.title: Memory guards
group_memory.description: Gates new memory writes behind a coverage check, lints memory content, warns on unopenable path citations, and records what a session authored.

group_attention.title: Attention hooks
group_attention.description: Desktop notifications, plus a Stop block that ends every reply with an operator-tag line, a Stop send-back for a handed-back `!` command with no operator:run tag, ask-gate for questions, and advisory-ack and unattended-mode guards.

group_multi_session.title: Multi-session guards
group_multi_session.description: Asks before a write into a repo another live session is using, or outside this session's repo. Also simple-rules-guard: no codex resume --last, no sudo JDK switch, no main branch in your own repos, marked defaults, SendMessage rules.

group_planning.title: Planning guards
group_planning.description: Asks a plan to declare any tracked source file it names but never read, nudges to save approved plans, blocks CSS demo hacks, and blocks manual /compact before the handoff (needs authorship-record, Memory group).

disabled_hooks.title: Disabled hooks
disabled_hooks.description: Hook ids to turn off one by one, whatever their group says. Set with: agent-tiers configure --set disabled_hooks=<id>,<id> (or settings.json pluginConfigs).
